summary: Mixed day dominated by retail sector expansion and regulatory compliance orders. Amazon Now scales to 120+ cities, Sebi mandates investor warnings on broker platforms, while CCI faces internal integrity probe in cartel case.

bullets.text: Amazon Now ultra-fast delivery service expands to 120+ cities with orders doubling every quarter.
Sebi orders stock brokers display investor awareness messages on websites and trading apps under Project Jagrook.
Delhi High Court permits inquiry against CCI officer for tampering with evidence in ONGC cement cartel probe.
India's consumer durables market projected to reach ₹3-3.25 trillion by 2030, doubling current scale.
Sebi approves IPO papers for Carlsberg India, Matangi Rubber, Ujin Pharma and TMC Transformer.
